Front Office Host(ess)

As Front Office Host(ess) you are the first and last person our guests see, it starts with a smile. Your helpful, can-do approach and passion for great service will create an amazing impression each and every time.

Park Plaza Victoria Amsterdam is looking for a Front Office Host(ess) who will do their best to give guests a moment they won't forget and we will help you to achieve this goal.

Excited? We have more to share!

Benefits of working with us as Front Office Host(ess):

• Birthday bonus of €250 (gross, paid in the month of your birthday)
• Competitive salary
• Tasty meal during shift 
• Industry pension plan 
• 25 days holiday 
• 1 extra day off for your wellbeing
• Exciting job opportunities within PPHE Hotel Group across Europe
• Discounted hotel rates (extends to the Radisson Hotel Group worldwide and family & friends)
• 50% F&B discount at our restaurants and bars (for your whole party)
• Travel compensation (max €250 net pm based on full-time employment) 
• Recommend a friend scheme (earn up to €750 for each friend who joins us)
• 8% holiday allowance (paid yearly in May)
• Flexible working policy (if applicable)
• Annual company parties and outings
• Exclusive discounts in the employee benefit store (www.alleo.nl)
• Discount on the collective health insurance from VGZ
• Departmental incentive schemes
• Great (online) Learning & Development opportunities to grow your career
• An advanced onboarding program
• Access to the hotel gym during low peak hours

and more…

Are you the perfect match?

As a spontaneous and welcoming Front Office Host(ess), you:

• Have excellent interpersonal skills and able to connect with others
• Manage requests promptly, helpfully, politely and with a caring attitude
• Will be responsible for a smooth check in and check out process as well as taking ownership in making the guests' stay memorable
• Possess a good command of English and has excellent communication skills
• Share our values: Tru

 Job 
 Do you want to be part of the KAMILDAK B.V. team? 
At KAMILDAK B.V. no day is the same! Working at KAMILDAK B.V. also means variety and development in your work! Whether in the office or outside (on the roof), you play an important role every day. 
If your job is not listed, please send an open application to solliciteren@kamildak.nl accompanied by a short covering letter and extensive CV. Who knows, you might soon be sitting with us for coffee (or something else!)) 
Our company is looking for an employee for the position of Service Employee . 
We do not require many years of experience in the roof service industry, because new employees have the opportunity to develop within the company. With the gained experiance our recruited service technicians have the opportunity to quickly get promoted and be employed on a direct contract with the client. 
Requirements: - Driving licence category B - English or Dutch (communicative level) - Good manners - Ability to work in a team of 2-3 people - High motivation and commitment to work 
Duties: - Detection and removal of minor faults or leaks - Roof cleaning and maintenance - Creating ongoing reports - Taking care of the quality of provided services 
We offer: - stable employment - opportunity to grow - regular salaries - equipment and professional work clothes - salary increases with greater commitment 
If you're interested please send us your CV : solliciteren@kamildak.nl 
Organisatie 
Kamil Dak B.V. is een gezonde en groeiende organisatie. Wij zijn een dakdekkersbedrijf, gespecialiseerd in het leggen van kunststof daken in de utiliteitsbouw. Onze expertise ligt bij het realiseren van nieuwbouw alsook renovatie van industriële daken en utiliteitsbouw. Bij onze projecten dragen we kennis, kunde en kwaliteit hoog in het vaandel.
